Velvire opens its first repair atelier in Lyon

Lyon, 11 March 2025 — Velvire today opened a repair atelier on rue Sainte-Catherine, the first of five planned across France.

The atelier will repair any Velvire frame, whatever its age and whoever owns it now. Frames built before the brand moved to aluminium in 2014 will be serviced by the same two mechanics who built them.

"A bike that cannot be repaired is a bike we should not have built," said Claire Fontaine, founder of Velvire. "Durability is not a feature we added last year. It is the reason the company exists."

Velvire frames are made in a workshop of eleven people outside Saint-Étienne. The brand sells directly, in small runs, and has never discounted.

The atelier opens to the public on 18 March. Repairs are booked online and priced per part.
